tagline: Unofficial Blood on the Clocktower grimoire for in-person games
seoDescription: Run in-person Blood on the Clocktower games with an unofficial, community-made Storyteller grimoire. Track roles, reminders and night order offline, in nine languages.
unofficial: Unofficial, community-made companion for Blood on the Clocktower. Not affiliated with The Pandemonium Institute.
ownership: Blood on the Clocktower, its characters, art and ability text are the property of Steven Medway and The Pandemonium Institute.
noGames: No games yet. Start one and it is saved here.
deleteGameMessage: This permanently deletes the game and its log. This cannot be undone.
supportCreators: Enjoy Blood on the Clocktower? Consider {link} to support The Pandemonium Institute, the creators of the game.
